directive: Build GLASS Clock Oracle: symbol-only grammar for device/server/UTC/monotonic/IANA zone clocks and mean/apparent solar time via latitude/longitude, plus safe shell script teaching and a typing-only, tap-only GLASS interface hosted in owner's terminal.
origin: GLASS main AGENTS.md; GLASS_COMMISSION.md; CONTINUE.md; QITT and ENCYCLED sources
guards: No code execution from typed source; only show shell snippets
No raw hardware seconds claimed beyond monotonic clock and POSIX UTC API
Longitude determines mean solar offset, not legal/IANA time zone; latitude informs sun geometry not civil offset
No precise location or geolocation requested; all coordinates user supplied
Server time marked unavailable if server not connected; device clock is local observation
Default listen 127.0.0.1; remote use only by user-approved tunneled server
Persist nothing from typed source unless explicitly opted in
Finite grammar, bounded tests, no stealth browser/OS permission
Publish additively to GLASS/main with outcome actual remote verification
estimated_sources: Python standard library zoneinfo IANA rules
